facts.fact: Hetzner (Pty) Ltd announced the opening of a new data centre in Cape Town, its third overall, selling managed hosting and co-location; the date is the article's archive date.

facts.fact: Hetzner's Gallo Manor, Johannesburg data centre opened in August 2005 and had reached 70 percent capacity, serving its co-location and managed hosting market.
